title: INTRODUCTION TO RESEARCH METHODS
description: Introduces basic sociological research methods, including study design, measurement, sampling, surveying, and interviewing, as well as ethical and practical dilemmas in constructing sociological research. Emphasizes valuation and critique of existing research.
registration_restrictions:
Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a major in Public Policy (801) or Sociology (980).
